get.description:
Get URLs for Mobius instances in a region. The returned set will include instances in the requested region and the instances in the backup region that can be used in case of disaster recovery.
  1. If regionCode and countryCode both are provided, region matching both with be returned.
  2. If no countryCode is present, or no matching countryCode is found in region, one of the regions based on regionCode is returned.
  3. If no matching region found for regionCode, first entry based on countryCode will be returned.
  4. If no matching region found for regionCode and countryCode provided, default region is returned (based on the mobius instance being queried).
Clients are expected to retry in case of 5xx error responses.
get.summary: Discover mobius instances in a region.

200.description: List of Mobius URLs for the requested region.

post.description:
Make a call to a SIP or tel URI, from a specified device.
Some sample callee URIs are given below.
| Example | URI |
|------|-------------|
| SIP URI | sip:alice@wonderland.com |
| Tel URI for phone extension | tel:55256;phone-context=wonderland.com |
| Tel URI for E.164 number | tel:+14085551234 |
*NOTE: Need to check for the best way to represent these URIs over SIP to Webex Calling. We can mandate tel URIs for phone numbers, or we could support them on SIP URIs as well. Can decide on this later.*
This API is called along with a ROAP message containing offer SDP. The format of the message is kept the same as that sent to Locus today. ROAP JSON is treated as a string, as Mobius would ignore this just like Locus does - the value will be passed on to MSE for media negotiation.
Here is a [sample ROAP message](roap.html).

delete.description:
Delete (disconnect) a call using its id. This API would be called by the client in following cases:
1. Client-initiated disconnect for an established call.
2. In response to a call_disconnected event sent by server, mainly to send call metrics to the server.
3. Rejecting an incoming call from server.

    Cause code for call disconnect.
    | Code | Description |
    |------|-------------|
    | 0    | Normal disconnect |
    | 115  | User Busy  |
    | 131  | Media inactivity  |

correlationid.description:
UUID generated by client for each session (call). Client should include this value in all call-related messages sent to the server. This value would be stored by the server and will be included in all HTTP responses and async events corresponding to the session (call).
If correlationId is not available, as in the case of an incoming call event sent to the client, server will include a value of its choice - in the case of SIP interworking, the value will be the remote half key of the SIP session id.

device_200.description: Device created successfully. This maps to a successful SIP registration with Webex Calling, and the response is synchronous.

device_403.description:
Device could not be created.
If the per-user device limit is exceeded, server will return the list of web calling devices that currently mapped against the user. The SDK can choose to query these devices for their status and decide to delete them before attempting to create more devices.
*NOTE: In practice, the device limit would be set to 1, as Webex Calling supports only one registration for a given device type.*
Values of error codes:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 101  | Per-user device limit exceeded. |
| 102  | Device creation not enabled for user.|
| 103  | Device creation failed.|
